verdict.rationale: The quickstart doc (mistral-docs-1) implies a self-serve path to make an API call, and SDK/install docs (mistral-docs-12, mistral-docs-26) show trivial setup, suggesting no sales-call gating, but the evidence pack never explicitly documents the signup process, key-minting steps, or confirms absence of a waitlist. missing for 10: explicit docs on account creation/API key generation, confirmation of no waitlist, independent community confirmation of frictionless signup.
